img_702.description: Heavily blurred. Beige vellum; in the centre a horizontal grey-green shape that reads as a four-legged animal with a raised head/neck, a dark green leaf or tuft just left of it, and a faint lighter oval and curved line below. Faint ring text around.
img_702.central_figure: a grey-green four-legged animal (possibly a ram or goat) with a green plant beside it
img_702.sign_reason: Quadruped with raised neck and plant beside it, like a ram/goat; species not distinguishable at this blur, so ram is a guess over goat or bull.

img_962.sign_reason: Two parallel elongated horizontal shapes with a water-like line below suggest two fish.

img_912.description: Extremely blurred; only small grey-green dots near centre and faint ring structure; looks like it may be tiled/shuffled.

recognise_source: Yes, probably: the style (circular diagrams with a central animal or object, rings of text, figures in tubs/barrels, pale washes of green, blue and red) looks like the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408). Moderate confidence given the blur.
